title: [Bug]: e164 validation allows phone codes starting with +0
body:
### What happened?

Expected: validation error, phone codes starting with +0 are not allowed.
Actual: no error.

### Version

v10.28.0

### Example Code

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	validator "github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

func main() {
	v := validator.New(validator.WithRequiredStructEnabled())
	err := v.Var("+0123456789", "e164")
	fmt.Println(err)
}
```
comments: **@sashayakovtseva**: I confirm this is fixed on master. Waiting for new validator release.
